title: Ecosystem Integrations
content:
Photon's zero-shim architecture makes it easy to integrate with the broader JavaScript ecosystem. We provide official Orbits for common tasks and patterns for third-party tools.

Cloudflare / Workers

Photon is fully compatible with Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, and Queues. Since we use standard Web APIs, you can deploy your Gravito app with minimal configuration.

// wrangler.toml configuration
main = "src/server/index.ts"
compatibility_date = "2024-01-01"

Authentication (Better Auth / Auth.js)

While we recommend @gravito/sentinel, you can use any framework-agnostic auth library. Better Auth integrates seamlessly as a standard middleware.

import { auth } from './auth'

app.on(['POST', 'GET'], '/api/auth/*', (c) => {
  return auth.handler(c.req.raw)
})

GraphQL Orbit

@gravito/graphql provides a zero-config GraphQL server powered by Yoga. It mounts directly into your Photon route tree.

import { OrbitGraphQL } from '@gravito/graphql'

const graphQL = new OrbitGraphQL({
  schema: mySchema,
  path: '/graphql'
})

app.orbit(graphQL)

Stripe Webhooks

Handling Stripe signatures is reliable in Photon. Since we don't manipulate the raw body by default, signature verification always matches.

app.post('/webhook/stripe', async (c) => {
  const signature = c.req.header('stripe-signature')
  const body = await c.req.text()
  
  const event = stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(body, signature, secret)
  // Process event...
  return c.json({ received: true })
})

Monitoring (Sentry)

You can integrate Sentry using a global middleware that wraps the execution context.

import * as Sentry from '@sentry/bun'

app.use(async (c, next) => {
  try {
    await next()
  } catch (err) {
    Sentry.captureException(err)
    throw err
  }
})
